name: Crow Usage
author: crow
description: Claude usage from crow: 5h limit gauge and today's cost on the bar; limits and burn rate per account, today's spend and tokens, 7-day cost, top sessions today, savings in the panel.

command.label: Usage command
command.description: Prints the crow-usage JSON payload. Run with bash -lc; use an absolute path if crow is not on the login PATH.

interval.label: Refresh
interval.description: Seconds between polls (one poller per shell).

compactBelow.label: Compact below
compactBelow.description: When the bar is shorter than this (e.g. a vertical monitor), the pill shows only the gauge and %; the cost moves to the hover card. 0 = never compact.
